clue.text: Entitled to be a church member

definitions.text: Entitled to be a church member

parts.words: Entitled to be a church member
parts.note: entitled reads as given a title or name, as at a christening, which is also the rite of entry to the church

explanation.definitionFit: Christening both names a child and admits it into the Christian church.

clue.text: A cycle is available

parts.note: a round is one cycle of events, as in a round of talks

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a bicycle can be had.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycle' suggests a bicycle, but here it is a round.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is around is about and on hand, so available.

clue.text: Trunk with tangled roots

indicators.note: tangled says the letters of the word roots are knotted into a new order

explanation.surface: A tree trunk with its roots all knotted together.
explanation.walkthrough: The tree picture hides that the trunk is the body's.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk is the body without head or limbs, the anatomical term for it.

clue.text: Vessel requiring a mast to be re-rigged

indicators.note: re-rigged means rigged again in a new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ship needs its mast rigged afresh.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat driven by steam engines is a kind of vessel.

clue.text: She persuaded her admirer to take a short cut

definitions.text: She persuaded her admirer to take a short cut

parts.words: She persuaded her admirer to take a short cut
parts.note: the biblical temptress who coaxed Samson into having his hair cut, losing his strength

explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Judges the woman Samson loved betrayed him by having his hair shorn.

clue.text: It takes the strain out of brewing

definitions.text: It takes the strain out of brewing

parts.words: It takes the strain out of brewing
parts.note: strain is both stress and filtering; a small porous sachet of leaves needs no strainer

explanation.definitionFit: A porous sachet of leaves lets you brew a cuppa without any strainer.

clue.text: Upset about work, drinks

indicators.note: about says the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: read as set going up, in a down clue the word set written upward, TES
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone, upset over their job, takes to the bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' is split as up plus set: in a down clue set is written upwards. TOPE is an old word meaning to drink heavily.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is to drink heavily, so topes is a verb form meaning drinks.

clue.text: Here's quality, but in unusual attire

indicators.note: in says the word but is placed inside the other piece
unusual says the letters of attire are made odd by rearranging

explanation.surface: A quality on show, though dressed in strange clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Here's' is only a link to the definition; 'unusual' works on the dress word alone, and 'in' tucks the conjunction into it, just after its fifth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a characteristic or quality belonging to someone.

clue.text: Didn't refuse — that's normal

definitions.meaning: took what was offered, agreed to it

explanation.definitionFit: Received willingly, and also widely recognised as the usual practice.

clue.text: Pursue syllabus

definitions.meaning: to chase, as hounds chasing a hare

explanation.definitionFit: Hounds hunt game in this way, and a programme of lessons bears the same name.

clue.text: Drawer of Cupid's bow?

parts.note: Cupid's bow is the curve of the upper lip; a drawer here is something that draws its outline

explanation.definitionFit: Make-up applied to the mouth traces the curved upper lip called Cupid's bow.

clue.text: Tell a student to be relaxed

parts.note: to tell someone is to inform them
L for learner, from the L-plate on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: Someone instructs a pupil to calm down.
explanation.walkthrough: L-plates are the red-on-white L signs British learner drivers must display.
explanation.definitionFit: Casual and unceremonious, the opposite of formal.

clue.text: Evasive secret agent seen around border

indicators.note: seen around says the agent's letters enclose the next piece

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
a lip is a rim or edge

explanation.surface: A slippery spy spotted near a frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'border' suggests a frontier for the spy to cross, but it is a lip or edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Slippy is an informal form of slippery, hard to pin down.

clue.text: Happy to give duo more dough

indicators.note: give means to bend or yield, so the letters of the following words shift into a new order

explanation.surface: A pair would be glad to hand over more cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cheerful and genial is to be in a pleasant temper, so happy.

clue.text: Fabric, being dear, replaced

indicators.note: replaced means put back in a different place, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A cloth is swapped out because it is expensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaberdine is a hard-wearing twill cloth used for raincoats.

clue.text: Car demo to be organised — for a president?

definitions.note: a definition by example: a procession of vehicles carrying a head of state

indicators.note: organised says these letters are arranged into order afresh

explanation.surface: A car demonstration is being arranged, perhaps for a head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the question at the end: what is laid on for a president.
explanation.definitionFit: A procession of official cars escorting a dignitary, typically a head of state.

clue.text: Review TV show and quietly relax

parts.note: p is piano, the musical marking for quietly
to lay back is to recline and take it easy

explanation.surface: Watching a TV programme while sitting back peacefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'TV show' looks like a separate noun for the charade, but it belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Replaying a recording lets one review a programme, the sense of the noun here.

clue.text: Shakespeare's playhouse in the round?

parts.note: the theatre on Bankside named after the round world, and itself circular

explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's company performed at this circular Bankside theatre, named after the world.

clue.text: Former spouse sat in the open

parts.note: an ex is a former husband or wife
to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: An ex-partner sat for a picture outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposed means laid bare, uncovered and out in the open.

clue.text: Fireman who doesn't put fires out

definitions.text: Fireman who doesn't put fires out

parts.words: Fireman who doesn't put fires out
parts.note: a fireman in the older sense tends a furnace, keeping its fires going

explanation.definitionFit: On steam engines and ships, a stoker shovelled coal to feed the furnace.

clue.text: Why brides may conceal having mixed parentage

indicators.note: may conceal says the letters are tucked away inside the words Why brides

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about why brides keep their background secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Of mixed descent, as with offspring of two different breeds.

clue.text: Spots the sign of a faulty washer

definitions.text: the sign of a faulty washer
definitions.meaning: a leaking tap with a worn rubber washer lets water fall drop by drop

explanation.definitionFit: Small drops of liquid fall continually from a tap with a perished seal.

clue.text: Sycophant's aspirate misplaced

indicators.note: misplaced says the letters of aspirate are put in the wrong places

explanation.surface: A flatterer drops an H in the wrong spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasite is a hanger-on, a toady who lives off others' favour.

clue.text: Supports fights, but not seriously

definitions.meaning: poles or beams holding something up, such as a mast
boxers sparring practise without full force

explanation.definitionFit: Masts and booms are spars on a ship, and play-fighting boxers spar.

clue.text: They may be happy playing cards

definitions.text: They may be happy playing cards

parts.words: They may be happy playing cards
parts.note: Happy ... is a children's card game of collecting households

explanation.definitionFit: Happy Families is a card game in which players collect matching households.

clue.text: Naturally cold state, but sweet when baking hot outside

definitions.meaning: baked ... is a dessert of ice cream encased in hot browned meringue

explanation.walkthrough: Baked Alaska is ice cream in meringue flashed in a hot oven.
explanation.definitionFit: The icy US state lends its name to the meringue-covered ice-cream pudding.

clue.text: In cold weather they go downhill fast

definitions.text: In cold weather they go downhill fast

parts.words: In cold weather they go downhill fast
parts.note: go downhill suggests decline, but here people race down snowy slopes

explanation.definitionFit: Winter sports enthusiasts speed down snowy slopes on long runners.

clue.text: Items of furniture which are employed off stage

definitions.meaning: theatre staff who help actors into costume in the wings

explanation.definitionFit: Kitchen cabinets with shelves, and backstage staff who help actors change costume.
